title: Case study
overall_deck_description: This 8-slide corporate case study deck is built on a bold, tech-forward palette dominated by deep royal blue, accented with periwinkle/slate blue geometric facets, crisp white, and sharp magenta/coral highlights for data points. Typography is clean and modern, set in a clean humanist sans-serif with strong hierarchy (large white headings on dark backgrounds and deep blue headings on light surfaces). The visual identity is anchored by a sharp, multi-toned triangular geometric graphic consistently positioned in the upper right corner of full-bleed dark slides. The presentation flows structurally from a bold title slide (index 0) into content-rich two-column analyses (indices 1–2), transitioning through immersive full-bleed blue section dividers and callout slides (indices 3–4), and concluding with split-pane data visualizations, implementation frameworks, and summary slides (indices 5–7).
